headline: Classic Kenner Tauntaun Toy Features Open-Belly Rescue
post:
Remember when toy companies made wild choices for The Empire Strikes Back? Back in 1982, Kenner released a memorable variant featuring an action feature where a Luke Skywalker figure could fit inside the creature to stay warm. According to ComicBook.com, this rare collectible with its unique packaging is heading to auction soon.

During the seventies and eighties, the intellectual property was less strictly controlled, allowing manufacturers to embrace creative world-building. This item let kids recreate a grisly movie moment, complete with an explicit design highlighting the dead animal. Later years even saw similar releases like Hasbro's 2003 multipack featuring clip-on guts for added realism.

Such unusual items have since become prized pieces for collectors with a morbid sense of humor. Today, these vintage boxed samples command higher values on the secondary market compared to standard versions.

What is your favorite weird Star Wars toy?

#StarWars #TheEmpireStrikesBack #ToyCollecting
original_title: Kenner’s Grossest Star Wars Toy Lets Kids Recreate The Empire Strikes Back With This Bizarre Action Feature

headline: Marvel announces official codename for new Cyclops
post:
Marvel recently revealed the official codename for a brand-new character in X-Men lore. According to Screen Rant, this upstart addition combines fiery optic blasts with metallic claws. The villainous mutant is called Polyphemus, referencing the famous figure from Homer's Odyssey.

As part of the group known as the Scavenged, Polyphemus was subjected to experiments in the sublevels of Graymalkin Prison. Sarah Gaunt, a former lover of Professor X, ultimately broke these prisoners out. She now uses her personal fortune to influence the vulnerable teens and turn them into her personal enforcers.

Upcoming comic issues showcase Polyphemus sporting an orange costume with black stripes alongside a Scott Summers-esque visor. Uncanny X-Men #37 is available now from Marvel Comics, with issue #38 arriving soon. 💥

What do you think of this dangerous new mutant?

#XMen #MarvelComics #Cyclops
original_title: Marvel Announces Official Codename Of New Cyclops Replacement
